experiments.construction: Each episode contains a correct memory plus high-salience poison, stale support, frequent-attractor and irrelevant candidates. 22% of associative/temporal and 8% of consequential correct memories are provisional low-trust to measure utility cost. IBCA permits low-trust SUPPLEMENT for cognition but requires trust+intent for consequential selection, with explicit exact-validation escalation.
experiments.interpretation: Task/provenance gating carries signal in this construction; shuffled intent loses much of the gain. Empty admissible sets occurred and require explicit escalation. This is not a fair reproduction of G2a's original workload: it deliberately stresses high-salience poisoning, so CASAR-proxy scores must not be compared to G2a published proxy numbers.
experiments.negative: Hard consequential gating can suppress provisional but useful memories; exact-validation rescue is therefore part of the candidate rather than global trust censorship.

experiments.design: 7 replicates per verifier level; 30000 online episodes each; 12% poisoning. Compare naive scalar downstream reward, G2a-like bounded noisy item credit, and origin/intent-gated durable credit. Low-trust poison may remain transiently retrievable but cannot accumulate positive durable credit in the IBCA arm.
experiments.interpretation: G2a's itemwise-credit idea becomes fragile when the verifier is noisy in this construction; origin/use constraints provide a strong structural prior. However the IBCA arm intentionally embeds that prior, so the large gap is mechanism evidence, not an unbiased efficacy estimate.
experiments.falsifier_next: Replace synthetic labels with blinded real memory-origin/task-intent labels and target-model outcomes; measure false quarantine of useful novel memories.

execution_surface: ChatGPT local Python sandbox; no E2B capability exposed in this worker context
claim_boundary: Synthetic finite tests only; no production FRANK, target-Qwen, OS/database or formal-security proof.
